items.title: A Bad Day for Bank Stocks Is Killing the Dow

items.title: Goldman Sachs in talks to acquire Palmer Square, Bloomberg says
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs Group Inc (NYSE:GS) has emerged as the lead bidder to acquire Palmer Square Capital Management, a credit-focused asset manager overseeing $37 billion, according to reporting from Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter. The potential transaction marks the latest step in Goldman’s ongoing effort to bolster its $4 trillion asset management division.
